sectors.task: Audit exact Git identity, stale/current markers, generated projections and baseline drift.
Identify human-facing non-Polish documentation and prepare Polish translations while preserving technical tokens and evidence literals.
Audit README/index/navigation, duplicate paths, naming, discoverability and document ownership.
Verify AS_IS/CANDIDATE/TARGET semantics, action/runtime/factory descriptions and cross-document consistency.
Verify authority, policy, security boundary and no-authority-inflation statements.
Verify VKT-R3 runtime, Mission Control, image, test and currentness documentation against repository evidence.
Preserve historical commits, trees, PRs, falsification and supersession lineage; prevent destructive rewrites.
Validate Markdown/links/schema references, compare intended vs resulting documentation state and record unresolved gaps.

interpretation: This manifest materializes 128 logical documentation-worker identities by disjoint ID ranges. It does not claim 128 independent OS processes, Pods, model sessions or production executors.
